text:
eli-cs: FYI — ACME (customer) just opened a ticket: p99 latency jumped after we switched their route to `int8_aggressive` quant profile for rw-infer/llama2x-70b. p95 mostly unchanged, p99 ~320ms -> ~720ms.

maria-support: ugh. do we have a repro and request IDs? are they on Dedicated or Hosted?

eli-cs: Dedicated in us-west2. customer provided a sample request and a few request_ids: r_20260315_01, r_20260315_02. repro curl:

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "x-redwood-model: rw-infer/llama2x-70b" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize the document","max_tokens":256, "quant_profile":"int8_aggressive"}'
```

eli-cs: They say the first token in the response is fine but tail tokens experience long stalls and p99 spikes.

aj-dev: Possible causes:
- aggressive int8 path triggers an on-demand calibration step (if we don't have a cached calibration for that model+shape) which can block, esp for long sequences.
- or int8 kernels causing increased CPU/GPU syncs for small batch sizes (dedicated pool config matters).

aj-dev: Can you paste the server-side logs for one of the request_ids? look for "calibration" or "quantize: waiting" messages.

eli-cs: pasted logs (redacted):
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] request r_20260315_01 start
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] model rw-infer/llama2x-70b load ok
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] quant_profile=int8_aggressive
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] calibration: no cached profile, starting calibration (blocking)
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] kv_cache: miss, warming
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] first token -> 0.33s
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] calibration complete (1.1s)
[2026-03-15T14:02:13Z] tail throughput degraded, p99 ~0.72s
```

kai-ml: yep that's calibration blocking. int8_aggressive uses per-layer range calibration at runtime when no representative stats are available; that path can add ~1s on cold starts and can sometimes introduce jitter if it runs inline with user requests.

kai-ml: mitigation options (ordered from quick to long-term):
1) Immediate: set route-level override for this customer to `quant_profile: fp16` (force fallback). This avoids calibration entirely.
2) Short-term: change to `quant_profile: int8_mild` which uses precomputed ranges and skips blocking calibration.
3) Medium: enable async/background calibration/prewarm on model boot (we have a flag `calibration.mode=background`).
4) Long-term: upload a calibration artifact produced by our calibration service so the runtime finds cached stats for that model+shape.

sasha-eng: how do we toggle route-level override quickly? can do from Console or via API. example API call to patch customer route:

```
PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes/{route_id}
Authorization: Bearer $ADM_KEY
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "overrides": {"quant_profile": "fp16"},
  "note": "Temp rollback for ACME due to p99 spike from int8_aggressive calibration"
}
```

maria-support: i'll propose fp16 rollback to customer now and ask if they want a follow-up to test int8_mild later.

eli-cs: please also add a short-term rule to prefer `int8_mild` for small batch sizes. customer is sending mostly single-request per connection.

aj-dev: extra config knobs that help tail latency with quant paths:
- `calibration.mode=background` (non-blocking)
- `quant.fallback_on_latency=true` (if p99 > threshold, runtime routes to fp16 automatically)
- `inference.cache.prewarm=true` for Dedicated pools

aj-dev: we can also set a route policy to add header `x-redwood-model-variant: fp16` for that tenant until we get a stable int8 profile.

kai-ml: if someone wants to reproduce locally, run the calibration job against a representative prompt set:

```
# run calibration job (example)
POST /v1/models/rw-infer/llama2x-70b/calibrate
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "prompts": ["<list of representative prompts>"],
  "profile_name": "acme_llama2x_int8_aggressive_20260315"
}
```

kai-ml: upload the generated artifact to S3 path and reference in model manifest under `quant.calibration_artifact` so runtime will use it.

sasha-eng: added datadog query to the incident notes for tracking:
```
service:inference env:prod model:llama2x quant_profile:int8_aggressive | rollup(p99, 1m)
```

deploy-bot: Route patch applied by sasha-eng at 2026-03-15T15:00:00Z (overrides.quant_profile=fp16). :white_check_mark:

e li-cs: confirmed — rolled back route for ACME to fp16, watching p99 now. will monitor for 30m and then coordinate a controlled test with int8_mild.

maria-support: updated ticket and told customer we're rolling back, offered to schedule a perf test window.

aj-dev: follow-up engineering tasks:
- create a small-perf test that warms calibration in background for the common shapes
- add a runtime metric that emits "calibration.blocking_ms" per request
- add automated fallback rule for tenant routes when p99 exceeds threshold for 5m

eli-cs: thanks all. keeping this thread open until stable. :thumbsup:
